title: describe(...) with if constexpr
prompt: Implement `describe(args...)`: fold over the pack, and use `if constexpr` on each element's type to pick its prefix — `int(...)`, `dbl(...)` (via `std::to_string`), or `str(...)` for anything else. Elements join with single spaces.

tests.name: mixed pack described
tests.hint: Inside the fold: using U = std::decay_t<decltype(v)>; then if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<U>) -> int(...), else if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<U>) -> dbl(...), else str(std::string(v)...). Traits are false for references — decay first!

tests.name: single elements
tests.hint: The else-if chain must classify each type exactly once — no trailing space after the last element.
